title: Land fail-loud retrieval-eval guard on develop
description:
## Gate for TI-06361a

Before the ingestion agent applies **TI-06361a** (publication-date extraction + backfill) and re-measures the golden set, the ranking-lane fail-loud eval harness must be on `develop`.

Without it, a missing `PAPYRUS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME` (or missing lexical provider) silently scores semantic-only and can report false MRR / identifier collapses — the TI-b9f6da failure mode. Re-measure after a date backfill must not be able to lie that way.

## What must land

Branch `epic/repeatable-retrieval-eval` in the ranking worktree (tip includes `fec178d` and prefer-pubdate `bfc2f33`):

- `papyrus-main-ai-ml-readonly` env profile + lexical preflight floors
- `PAPYRUS_REQUIRE_LEXICAL` (engine + `build_environment_services`)
- Harness abort on lexical-unavailable warnings
- Provenance fields: lexical docs / unique refs / accepted count
- Freshness `prefer_order` goldens (so age-decay can be observed)

## Done when

- Merged to `develop` (and available to the ingestion agent's checkout)
- `poetry run python3 procedures/newsroom/retrieval_eval.py --env papyrus-main-ai-ml-readonly` refuses to score if lexical cannot load

This story blocks **TI-06361a**. Ingestion agent: do not start TI-06361a apply until this is closed.
